profile_source: English adaptation of supplied MYLIFE twelve-question interview; birth details are reused from the master chart. Unanswered fields stay empty.
practice_source: Titles and reflection prompts from supplied Self-Discovery GAME_CONFIG.

questions.label: Your present situation
questions.prompt: Your birth details already belong to your chart. What would you like to share about your life today?

questions.label: Work and resources
questions.prompt: What do you currently do, and how are you supported financially?

questions.label: Strengths
questions.prompt: Name up to three strengths. How strong does each feel, from 1 to 10?

questions.label: Difficulties
questions.prompt: Name up to three recurring difficulties. How much does each affect you, from 1 to 10?

questions.label: Your first priority
questions.prompt: What matters most to you right now, and why?

questions.label: A concrete picture
questions.prompt: If that priority were going well, what would you actually see happening?

questions.label: Other priorities
questions.prompt: What are your second and third priorities?

questions.label: Longer direction
questions.prompt: Five years from now, where would you like to be, with whom, doing what?

questions.label: A recurring loop
questions.prompt: What situation tends to repeat: what happens, what do you do, and how does it end?

questions.label: Early signals
questions.prompt: What two or three signs tell you that things are becoming difficult?

questions.label: What supports you
questions.prompt: What two or three habits or conditions help you stay steady?

questions.label: This quarter
questions.prompt: What are up to three goals that would make the next three months worthwhile?

practice_options.title: Self Reflection
prompts: What makes you unique?
What do you love about yourself?
When do you feel most like you?
What is something only you can do?
What makes you smile inside?

practice_options.title: Purpose Pattern
prompts: What do you want to create?
How do you want to help others?
What problem do you want to solve?
What makes you feel useful?
What would you do if you could do anything?

practice_options.title: Heart Link
prompts: Who makes you feel understood?
How do you show you care?
What do you value in a friend?
When do you feel connected?
What makes a relationship special?

practice_options.title: Strength Recall
prompts: When were you brave?
What challenge have you overcome?
What are you proud of?
When did you surprise yourself?
What strength do others see in you?

story_paths.label: Remember
story_paths.text: Who were you before this moment?

story_paths.label: Explore
story_paths.text: The void ripples around you, revealing hidden patterns.

story_paths.label: Dream
story_paths.text: You see yourself—many selves—reflected in an infinite mirror.
